title: Reproducibility of Accounting Research: Views of the Research Community

scopes.description: Supplied survey response workflow: use the author-provided raw responses and the Excel computations workbook to summarize 15 survey questions plus two demographic questions and calculate the manuscript percentages. Survey administration is historical context, not a live stage.

requirements.description: Author-prepared survey responses in 02 HLL Survey - Raw Data.xlsx (Survey - Raw Data sheet); the datasheet states the release contains 136 full or partial responses. This is the primary data route, subject to reconciling its transfer or link to the Computations workbook's Data sheet.

routes.description: The supplied bounded probe reports the workbook readable and lists 52 headers. The Computations workbook Data sheet has the same 52 named headers in the same order, with 40 unheaded formula-helper columns between/after them. The probe reads one header row only; it does not verify all 136 response records or the transfer/link path into Data.

actions.description: Use the supplied author-prepared raw response workbook as the primary input and establish how its rows populate the computation workbook's Data sheet before refreshing calculations.
steps: Make a working copy of both XLSX files, preserving the original hashes recorded in the work item.

Use the computations workbook with original SHA-256 ad397efb6999bfe32e36033dcb33240b970279003fda586d78004596f1ffc7d5 as the base. Its exact formula and PivotTable locations are in probes/workbook_program_coverage_v4.json.

Confirm the Data sheet's 52 named columns and the response-row range against 02 HLL Survey - Raw Data.xlsx; record whether the source is copied, linked, or otherwise staged and keep helper-formula columns aligned.
Do not infer row-level equality from matching headers or the one-row probe; resolve any missing or stale handoff in the working copy.
validation: Record the raw input and Data-sheet source relationship and verify the intended survey rows are present before pivot refresh.

actions.description: Run the supplied Excel computations workbook in a compatible Excel release after the Data-sheet handoff is established.
steps: Identify and record the Microsoft Excel release used for recalculation and PivotTable refresh; do not assume compatibility from an installed LibreOffice executable.

In the working copy, recalculate the Data-sheet IF formulas, refresh the 42 PivotTables whose source ranges are on Data and destinations are on Computations, then recalculate the 29 GETPIVOTDATA-containing result formulas on Computations.
Save the refreshed workbook copy and preserve formula/pivot error messages and engine/version details.
Compare workbook percentages with the manuscript only when the expected manuscript values are available; the article's numerical results are not part of the frozen material set.
validation: Check that all listed pivot tables refresh, all formula outputs are populated without errors, and the workbook's summaries/percentages can be reconciled to the author-reported results when available.

review_notes: The computation workbook is substantive supplied author code and the full-pipeline entry point; stored formulas and PivotTables perform the documented survey computations.
No analysis-only scope is justified; the supplied workbook is the analysis workflow itself, and no separate prepared analysis dataset route is documented.
The survey was already collected through Qualtrics; no respondent recollection, contact, collection reenactment, or independent reconstruction is in scope.

The raw workbook is a locally supplied author-prepared input, and its 52 named headers match the Computations.Data named headers on bounded probes. Whole-file response coverage and the transfer/link path to Data remain unverified.

The static inspection accounts for 5,440 Data-sheet IF formulas, 29 Computations formulas containing GETPIVOTDATA, and all 42 PivotTables. The author-used Excel release, pivot refresh state, and output agreement remain unverified. No Office application was launched and no formula or pivot was evaluated.
The frozen work item contains no dependency-checklist edges; the ordered spreadsheet source and range trace covers the observed program and input handoff.
